items.title: Hong Kong taxi driver arrested after 2 Britons hit by cab in Wan Chai

items.title: Chisholm scores lone goal as AFC Toronto tops Montreal Roses for first NSL title
items.summary: AFC Toronto defeated the Montreal Roses 1-0 from Ottawa’s TD Place in the Northern Super League final on Saturday to win the Diana B. Matheson Cup for the first time in club history.
